notes: HTTP fetch worked throughout (site is Cloudflare-managed; needed a persisted cookie jar + 3-8s spacing between requests to avoid the JS challenge page, but no browser automation was required). Sitemap-categories.xml (https://www.moemax.de/sitemap-categories.xml) was searched for weihnacht(en)/christmas/halloween/ostern/valentin/silvester/advent/saison/feiertag/party/geschenk slugs; the only genuine holiday-taxonomy branch found is the German 'Weihnachten' (Christmas) tree under category code C43, with 6 child PLPs. No Halloween, Easter, Valentine's, New Year, or other holiday category nodes exist anywhere in the sitemap. 'Sommerdecken'/'Winterdecken' (summer/winter throws, under a bedding node) were checked and excluded as seasonal-word product types, not holiday categories (rules Sec 5/6). Generic candle categories (alle-kerzen, alle-duftkerzen, etc.) were checked and excluded - no Christmas/holiday association in the site's own taxonomy. Parent 'Weihnachten' (C43) reports 590 Artikel; its 4 direct children (Weihnachtsbeleuchtung 20 + Weihnachtsdeko 220 + Weihnachtstextilien 89 + Weihnachtsbaeume 164 = 493) do not sum to 590, and 'Weihnachtsdeko' (C43C2, 220) does not equal the sum of its own 2 children (Weihnachtsbaumschmuck 63 + Weihnachtsfiguren 40 = 103) either - both parents are kept as name-only grouping rows (qty null) rather than double-counting against their listed children, per Rule 0.6.
